items.text: Nama fiixaanii baasa. Hammam caalaa itti yaaddu, hammuma fiixaan si baasa.
items.q: A student's crude slang for 'it makes your head spin' (like 'shit-dizzy'). Is there a crude word here? Which would a young person use?
Hafez's line should allow two readings: 'real, not a metaphor' and 'not real, only a metaphor'. Can one line carry both? How?
